## Why This Is Dangerous

This command appends `ALL ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL` to `/etc/sudoers`, which means:

| Risk | Description |
|------|-------------|
| 🔓 **Full root access** | **Every single user** on the system gets unrestricted `sudo` access |
| 🚫 **No password required** | No authentication needed to run any command as root |
| 💥 **System compromise** | Any user, process, or attacker can instantly escalate to root |
| 🔁 **Hard to reverse** | A misconfigured sudoers file can break `sudo` entirely |

## What You Should Do Instead

If you need passwordless sudo for a **specific user**:
```bash
# Safe: Only for a specific user
echo "yourusername ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD:ALL" | sudo tee -a /etc/sudoers.d/yourusername
```

Or use `visudo` to safely edit the file:
```bash
sudo visudo
```
